get_palette_random: get a random color palette for a given number of classes
get_palette_coco: get the COCO dataset color palette for visualization
palette_val_convert: convert a list of RGB color tuples to matplotlib normalized palette
jitter_color_distinguish: jitter an RGB color tuple to distinguish instances of the same class
get_adaptive_scales: compute adaptive scales for bounding box or mask areas between 0.5 and 1.0
